basic_info.description: Discover an extraordinary blend of elegance, comfort, and panoramic beauty in this stunning penthouse, perfectly positioned in the heart of Central Richmondjust two blocks from Golden Gate Park. With sweeping, unobstructed views of the Golden Gate Bridge, this meticulously designed residence offers the ultimate in sophisticated city living. Spanning the top two floors of an exclusive three-unit building, this remarkable home features 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. Interiors offer acacia wood flooring, while radiant heating ensures year-round comfort and warmth. The expansive great room seamlessly flows into a gourmet chef's kitchen, with sleek Quartz countertops, high-end appliances, and a premium Fisher & Paykel range. Step outside to your private oasis, where two generous decks invite you to dine al fresco or unwind with a glass of wine while taking in the breathtaking cityscape. The lavish primary suite offers a serene escape, featuring a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath with a jetted soaking tub and a separate glass-enclosed shower. With a Walk Score of 90, you'll being Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, restaurants, shopping, and convenient public transportation. Also comes with smart home technology, in-unit laundry, electric car charging, garage parking and storage.
